title: Text expansion
description: A snippet's keyword typed in any app is replaced by its text as you type. The snippets are the Snippets palette's.

settings.label: Expand as you type
settings.text: Replace a keyword typed in any app with its snippet
settings.description: macOS only. Type the prefix and the keyword (`;sig`) in any text field and the snippet is pasted in its place, placeholders filled, `{cursor}` placing the caret. Needs Accessibility and Input Monitoring for pal. Off by default.

settings.label: Prefix
settings.description: What comes before the keyword: `;sig` (the default), `:sig`, or the bare keyword at the start of a word (`sig`, which also fires inside ordinary typing).

settings.label: Never expand in
settings.description: Bundle ids of apps where nothing expands: terminals (a keyword is a command there) and password managers by default. Secure text fields (a password field, sudo) never expand anywhere.

settings.label: Flash the HUD
settings.text: Show "Expanded <name>" in the HUD after an expansion
